scope: Named initial-profile source modules; own non-underscore functions and own structs; private-name convention is not enforced access control

source_comments: Integer byte encoding: unsigned 16/32 bits and signed 64 bits, exact lengths.
Public helpers accept width 2/4/8 and reverse 0 (little) or 1 (big).
IEEE binary64 records: order 0 = little endian, 1 = big endian.
Conversion preserves raw bits; decoded lists and encoded bytes are independent.
RFC 4648 standard alphabet with canonical, required padding.
URI percent encoding preserves bytes; '+' is literal, not form whitespace.
Strict comma CSV over Unicode scalar text; blank records do not consume rows.
One Unicode CSV record with CRLF; zero fields are ambiguous and rejected.
A single empty field is quoted so it is distinct from an ignored blank record.
Full JSON documents over Unicode scalar text; preserve member order and lexemes.
A sorted, nonrecursive snapshot; metadata is queried after enumerating names.
Configuration values are read at each call; no process-wide cache.
Preserve the str API while avoiding whole-document row materialization.
Completed rows and chunk temporaries do not escape this helper frame.
Caller retains the file. Memory depends on chunk and pending row, not row count.
No row-size restriction is added; very long fields remain supported.
The public contract is unchanged; the byte state avoids unused field/row objects.
LF-delimited UTF-8 JSON; max_line excludes LF and is capped at 1 MiB.
Replies preserve number lexemes, member order and duplicate members.
The peer must consume replies while uploading. Readiness waits are per operation;
sockets must be nonblocking; timeout is not a total request deadline.
JSON escaping can expand output; each response is bounded by 6 * max_line + 1 bytes.
At most one reply and one 8192-byte received chunk are retained per peer.
Keep temporary receive/send byte arenas within one I/O operation.
LF-delimited UTF-8 JSON, preserving number lexemes, member order and duplicates.
max_line excludes LF; its fixed safety cap is 1 MiB. Replies <=6*max_line+1.
idle_ms is a batch-wide wait with no ready events, not a per-peer request deadline.
A stalled peer remains active until EOF/error or the batch's idle wait expires.
Caller owns listener; all accepted peers are closed here, including on failure.
peer_ms bounds time without actual received/sent bytes for each accepted peer.
total_ms bounds the whole batch, including continued traffic. Zero disables either.
Deadlines are checked between operations; this is not a real-time scheduling guarantee.
Little-endian signed int64 records, grouped into complete rows with checked prefixes.
Returns all ASCII decimal totals with LF, and produces no stdout before validation finishes.
Caller retains the open reader; read chunks 1..1MiB; partial record/row or overflow is ValueError.
Memory retains output plus a bounded chunk; the final bytes result is an immutable snapshot.

excludes: builtins and methods without source declarations
claim of all API runtime qualification
qualification_scope: Source/type checks at generation only; behavior/ownership/errors require SEMANTICS and runtime evidence
